title: Investors get real-time view of UK bond market activity for the first time
summary: The UK's Financial Conduct Authority (FCA) has introduced real-time transparency for the UK bond market, allowing investors to view bond market activity as it happens for the first time. This marks a significant shift in market surveillance and accessibility of financial data.
problem_solved: Lack of transparency and real-time visibility into UK bond market trading activity for retail and institutional investors
why_valuable: This regulatory change improves market fairness, enables better investment decision-making, and levels the playing field between institutional and retail investors by providing equal access to critical market information
